title: Design System: SACC — Sana Al-Awael Contracting Company

extensions.referenceImplementation: prototype/src (styles.css, app.js, template.html), bundled to prototype/dist/sacc-prototype.html; carried into frontend/ on owner approval

display.purpose: Home opening headline on asphalt only.

display-ar.purpose: Arabic opening headline: zero tracking, taller leading.

page-title.purpose: Inner page heads; compact sub-page heads use clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 3rem).

figure.purpose: Record values, years, standards in tabular numerals.

shadows.name: kerb-lip
shadows.purpose: Under the yellow primary action only.

shadows.name: field-sheet
shadows.purpose: The form sheet, the one lifted surface (with a 4px ink top edge).

shadows.name: inset-outline
shadows.purpose: How outline buttons, chips, tags and the language toggle draw their border; var(--asphalt-line) on dark.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused form field; invalid fields use 0 0 0 3px rgba(179, 38, 30, 0.22).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition and animation.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, outline and opacity changes on hover, press and selection.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The street section layers settle downward once on load.

motion.name: swap
motion.purpose: Discipline reader swap after a network is selected.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes all animation and transitions

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Sticky asphalt masthead; the current page carries a solid yellow bar.
components.html: ServicesProjectsCertificationsContact
components.css: .ds-mast { display: flex; gap: 2px; align-items: center; height: 72px; padding-inline: 24px; background: #17181a; border-bottom: 1px solid #3d3e43; font-family: 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mast a { position: relative; padding: 10px 11px; color: #bdb9b0; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.93rem; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-mast a:hover, .ds-mast a[aria-current='page'] { color: #f3f2ed; } .ds-mast a[aria-current='page']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 11px; bottom: 2px; height: 2px; background: #f6b81c; } .ds-mast a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6b81c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: In-page tabs on a 2px ink rule; selected tab gets a 3px solid yellow bar and a count chip.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 28px; border-bottom: 2px solid #17181a; } .ds-tabs [role='tab'] { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Alexandria', 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5f5b54; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs [role='tab']:hover { color: #17181a; } .ds-tabs [aria-selected='true'] { color: #17181a; font-weight: 650; } .ds-tabs [aria-selected='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 3px; background: #f6b81c; } .ds-tabs span { font-family: 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; min-width: 26px; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 2px; background: #e2e4e3; color: #47443f; } .ds-tabs [role='tab']:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6b81c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Qualification Record
components.description: Ruled record of figures and labels on paper; the signature record beside the street section.
components.css: .ds-record { margin: 0; max-width: 340px; background: #f3f4f3; color: #17181a; font-family: 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-record h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Alexandria', 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 20px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #17181a; } .ds-record div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.4em 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 7px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c5c8c6; } .ds-record dt { font-family: 'Alexandria', 'Readex Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.12rem; line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-record dd { margin: 0; font-size: 0.88rem; color: #47443f; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: Road Edge and Seam
components.description: Where the asphalt opening ends: the one dashed lane-marking strip; elsewhere a seam of thin strata marks a ground change.
components.css: .ds-roadedge { position: relative; height: 28px; background: #17181a; } .ds-roadedge::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 9px; height: 4px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #f6b81c 0 46px, transparent 46px 82px); opacity: 0.92; } .ds-roadedge::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 4px; height: 2px; background: #e9e7df; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-seam { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 6px 4px 8px; } .ds-seam i:nth-child(1) { background: #2c2d31; } .ds-seam i:nth-child(2) { background: #6b675f; } .ds-seam i:nth-child(3) { background: #8b857a radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 1px, transparent 1.6px) 0 0 / 9px 7px; }

narrative.overview:
SACC builds what lies under and along a Saudi street, so the site is drawn as a section through one. Every ground is a stratum: asphalt black for the official bar, the masthead, the opening and inner page heads; a concrete-grey reading ground; wadi-sand and Madinah-basalt bands for proof and fleet. The signature is an interactive street section directly under the opening: road layers above pipes and ducts, each network labelled and selectable, with a depth ruler in tabular numerals and the qualification record standing along its inline-end edge. The world refuses the contractor default of a full-bleed site photo, a stat band and a grid of service cards.

The register is formal and institutional, written for procurement officers. Information is set as records, logs, fact sheets and ruled lists rather than cards: hairline rules (1px) separate rows, and a heavier 2px ink rule opens every list the way a leader line opens an engineering drawing. Display weights stay calm (600 to 650); emphasis comes from the strata and the ruled structure, not from size or effects. Motion is one gesture: the section's layers settle downward once.

The site is Arabic-first and fully bilingual. Direction is a document-level concern (`lang`/`dir` on `<html>`), and layout is written in logical properties (`inline-start`, `inline-end`, `margin-inline`, `padding-block`) so the whole world mirrors without per-component overrides. The SACC logo is a pre-existing brand asset; it is placed only on dark grounds at 34px height and is never redrawn or recoloured. Its four arcs supply the network colours.
keyCharacteristics: Grounds are strata: asphalt, concrete, sand, basalt, stacked like a street section.
Road-marking yellow is the action colour; network colours are functional keys.
Ruled records and logs instead of cards; 2px ink rule opens, 1px hairlines divide.
Alexandria for display, Readex Pro for text, tabular numerals for every figure and depth.
One settling motion; no parallax, no ticker.

rules.name: The Road Marking Rule
rules.body: Yellow fills a surface only on the primary action. Everywhere else it appears as a line of 4px or less (active marker, focus ring, underline, leader tick) or a small mark. A yellow panel, band or card is off-world.

rules.name: The Network Key Rule
rules.body: Teal, orange, green and road yellow mean water, power, sewer/storm/landscape and roads. Use them only where a network is being identified: the section, the legend segments, discipline icons, project logs. Never as general decoration or a second accent.

rules.name: The Strata Rule
rules.body: Grounds change only by stratum: asphalt, concrete ground or paper, sand, basalt. Where the home page moves from one ground to the next, a seam of thin strata bands (asphalt-3, a mid-grey, aggregate texture) marks the join.

rules.name: The Calm Weight Rule
rules.body: Display never goes above 650 and headings sit at 600 to 650. Size and the strata carry hierarchy; heavy black weights are off-register. Only figures take 700.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that is compared or measured (years, counts, depths, standards) is set with tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Script Parity Rule
rules.body: Negative tracking applies to Latin only; Arabic headings get zero letter-spacing and more line-height (1.32 to 1.35 for headings, 1.8 for body). Never uppercase-transform text; Arabic has no case and the two languages must match.

rules.name: The Logical Axis Rule
rules.body: Write every offset, border and alignment with logical properties (inline-start/end, block). The few physical padding overrides keyed to `dir='rtl'` in the reference stylesheet are debt, not pattern.

rules.name: The Flat Strata Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat on their stratum. Only the form sheet lifts; nothing hovers into shadow.

rules.name: The Solid Marker Rule
rules.body: Active markers in nav and tabs are solid bars. Dashes belong to the drawing (lane dashes, leader lines and conduits inside the street section) and to the single lane-marking strip where the road band ends; never to UI state.

dos: Do spend road-marking yellow as a fill only on the primary action, and keep exactly one such action per region.
Do use network colours only to identify water, power, sewer/storm/landscape and roads, with their `-ink` partners for text on light grounds.
Do set lists as ruled records: a 2px ink rule to open, 1px hairlines between rows.
Do keep corners at 2px and surfaces flat; the form sheet is the only lifted surface.
Do write layout in logical properties so Arabic and English mirror from `dir` alone, and give Arabic headings zero tracking and taller leading.
Do set every compared figure in tabular lining numerals.
Do place the logo unaltered on dark grounds at 34px height.
Do wrap all motion in `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`; the reduce branch removes animation and transitions.
donts: Don't build a full-bleed site photo with a stat band and a grid of service cards; that is the contractor default this world refuses.
Don't use dashed or dotted markers for active nav, tab or selection state; dashes stay inside the street drawing and the single road-edge strip.
Don't fill panels, bands or cards with yellow, or use a network colour as decoration.
Don't add parallax, tickers, or repeating entrance animations; the section settles once.
Don't push display weight above 650 or uppercase-transform any text.
Don't redraw, recolour or place the logo on a light ground.
Don't load fonts from a CDN; Alexandria and Readex Pro are self-hosted.
